text_en: Look what you've become. Look at yourselves and tell me if you recognise anything at all.
Something I refuse to be a part of.
As firstborn, I'm walking away from these ridiculous wars. I'll grant you my territories, as well as all my disciples, on the condition you redirect the souls to a planet of my choice.

You can continue to receive mercenaries, but only if they themselves choose to come. Don't worry, they will have to pass a test to prove themselves worthy, so you will only receive soldiers capable of serving you. I'll send them myself, how you use them will be up to you.
